# Temporal durable execution for agentic AI in production


At enterprise scale, crashes, timeouts, and long waits for human approval can erase the progress of an[agentic workflow](https://www.griddynamics.com/glossary/agentic-ai-workflows) . Four[Temporal capabilities](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/temporal-agentic-ai-platform) help agentic AI work reliably in production.


1. [Temporal durable execution](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/temporal-financial-workflows) persists state at every step, so crashes become pauses and workflows resume from the exact point of interruption. When a multi-step process fails partway, compensating actions roll it back in reverse order to a stable state. For long-running tasks, that means no manual restarts and a complete audit trail.
2. [Multi-agent orchestration](https://www.griddynamics.com/blog/multi-agent-enterprise-workflows-case-study) lets one orchestration agent delegate to specialist agents, each running as an isolated workflow, so failures stay contained. Specialist agents work in parallel with each optimized for its domain.
3. [Human-in-the-loop workflows](https://www.griddynamics.com/blog/enterprise-agentic-ai-platform) wait for approvals without idle infrastructure spend and resume instantly when a person responds through any channel.
4. Without visibility at scale,[token consumption, LLM costs, and performance](https://www.griddynamics.com/blog/llm-cost-optimization) can spiral out of control. **Full execution history** and telemetry integration trace every prompt, tool call, retry, and LLM cost. Engineers can debug any workflow, and the business can track spending by department.


Hear Grid Dynamics CTO Eugene Steinberg and Temporal CTO Maxim Fateev explain why production belongs in your design from the first day. At Grid Dynamics, we closed the gap between pilot and production by moving retry policies, queues, and homegrown state storage to Temporal. Now we can focus more on business logic and customer results.


Watch the video to learn how Temporal can help your team go to production and stay in production.
